description: Rename or remove a tag across your whole durable memory. Give the tag to change, then the tag to use instead: every node that has the first gets the second, once. Give only one tag to remove it from every node. Use it to fold variants of one tag into a single spelling; the index lists the tags in use. Examples: ["escalations", "escalation"], ["misc"]. If the command exits with code 75 ("busy" or "changed on disk"), run the same command again.
